question: Which of the following places is decided to be the host of the FINA World Championships (25m) 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Melbourne, Australia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **FINA **is pleased to advertise that** Melbourne, Australia, will host the 16th FINA World Swimming Crowns (25m) 2022 at th**e Melbourne Sports and Submarine Centre from** 13-18 December 2022.**
 
• It'll be the first time that Melbourne has hosted this prestigious **25- cadence event, with the state-of-the-art**
 
• **Melbourne Sports and Submarine Centre is the host point.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **About FINA World Championships:**

 
 
• The FINA World Crowns or World Aquatics Championships are the World Championships for aquatics sports **swimming, diving, high diving, open water swimming, cultural swimming, and water polo.**
 
• They're run by **FINA**, and all swimming events are queried in a long course( 50- metre) pool.
 
• The event was first held in **1973 in Belgrade, Yugoslavia, and is now held every two years.**
 
• **From 1978 to 1998,** the World Championships were held every four years, in the even years between the** Summer Olympic years.**
 
• **From 2001 until 2019,** the Championships have been held every two years, in the odd years.
